verdicts.note: Bt toxin order B(produce crystals)->E(ingested)->C(alkaline pH solubilises)->A(activated)->D(binds midgut/pores/death); only option consistent with the logical sequence (matches NCERT).
Noise stress stimulates adrenaline secretion, causing nervousness/irritability. Correct.
UV-B is absorbed by DNA causing dimers/mutations; UV-C blocked by ozone, UV-A least energetic. UV-B correct.
FOAM/Arcata Marsh = integrated sewage and water treatment (NCERT). Correct.
Eutrophication: fertilizer runoff (i) + green/stinky algal bloom (iii) -> O2 depletion -> fish kill. (i) and (iii) correct (known NEET item).
IUCN maintains the Red Data Book. Correct.
Habitat destruction/loss is the leading cause of biodiversity loss (Evil Quartet). Correct.
Naming, examining related species, and geographic-range assessment are steps; quantifying the genome is the clear outlier. Correct.

N vs F ordering is convention-dependent: described-species counts give angiosperms(~2.5L)>fungi(~72k) i.e. N>F, but estimated fungal diversity (~1.5M) gives F>N. Stated F>N>A>P defensible under estimated-diversity convention; cannot confidently confirm or refute.
Fall in oestrogen/progesterone -> vasoconstriction and sloughing of endometrium (menstruation). Correct.
Steroid hormones are hydrophobic/lipid-soluble and pass through the membrane to intracellular receptors. Correct.
Hormones act by binding a receptor; only option capturing the universal receptor mechanism. Correct/best.
Azotobacter = free-living, aerobic, non-photosynthetic N2-fixer (Rhizobium symbiotic, Nostoc photosynthetic). Correct.
ANF inhibits (not stimulates) aldosterone; 'Stimulates aldosterone secretion' is the non-function. Correct.
Peritoneal dialysis works by diffusion between abdominal capillaries and the dialysis fluid. Correct.
Telophase (spindle breaks down, nuclear envelope reforms) is the reverse of prophase. Correct.
In stable environments genetically identical offspring are preadapted. Correct.
Apomixis (seed formation without fertilization) uses non-vegetative parts; corms/bulbs/rhizomes are vegetative. Correct.
Under stress, sexual reproduction generates new recombinant combinations increasing diversity. Correct.
Elimination: (i) CO2 higher solubility TRUE, (ii) ~7% (not 8-9%) dissolved in plasma FALSE, (iii) tissue CO2->RBC->H2CO3 TRUE -> only option a consistent. Correct despite truncated (iv)/(v).
(i) arteries thick/narrow lumen TRUE, (iv) Ca2+ in clotting TRUE; (ii) angina=heart not brain FALSE, (iii) AB=universal recipient not donor FALSE. (i) and (iv) correct.
Population < species < community < ecosystem is the only sensible increasing-complexity order. Correct.
fertilization->zygote->cleavage->morula->blastula->gastrula is the correct developmental sequence. Correct.
Plasmids are vectors because they are small circular DNA with their own origin of replication (autonomous). Correct.
Universal double-helix structure/nucleotide chemistry lets the same techniques work across species. Correct.
Diaphragm's chief function is ventilation (breathing). Correct.
DNA replicates in the nucleus; centrioles duplicate in the cytoplasm. Correct.
Charged/polar R groups line the channel pore permitting hydrophilic ion passage. Correct.
Plasma membrane is present in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes (others are eukaryote-only). Correct.
Removing decomposers blocks mineral/nutrient recycling (energy flow is one-way regardless). Correct.
Stratification is a structural feature, not an ecosystem function (energy flow/decomposition/productivity are). Correct.
Sparrow (grains=primary consumer, insects=secondary consumer) occupies more than one trophic level. Correct.
Agro-ecosystem (crop field) is a man-made/artificial ecosystem. Correct.
Polio vaccine antigen triggers the body's own immune response = active immunization. Correct.
a=viral, b=protozoan, c=helminthic homogeneous groups; d (Cancer/TB/Tetanus) is mixed cause = odd one out. Correct.
Antivenin (preformed antibodies) = artificially acquired passive immunity. Correct.
Mammalian cells glycosylate proteins (make glycoproteins); bacteria cannot. Correct.

Genuinely contested: cow-milk yellow is classically attributed to carotene (cows do not fully convert beta-carotene to vit A, unlike buffalo), but riboflavin (lactoflavin) is also a real yellow milk pigment. Cannot confidently confirm riboflavin nor call it definitively wrong.
Pancreas manufactures many digestive enzymes (exocrine); other options false. Correct/best.
Large intestine reabsorbs most remaining water from waste. Correct.
Cryptochromes are blue/UV-A photoreceptors; phytochromes absorb red/far-red. Correct.
Archaebacteria and N-fixing bacteria fall under Monera in the five-kingdom system. Correct.
Order is below Class; same order implies same Class (Family/Genus/Species are lower, not guaranteed). Correct.
Mycoplasma is pleomorphic due to absence of cell wall (option-d has OCR/DPP metadata junk but answer is clear). Correct.
Spirulina is single-cell protein, rich in proteins. Correct.
Branchiostoma is Cephalochordata not Hemichordata, so only (iii) is false; (i),(ii),(iv) true. '(iii) only' correct.
Octopus vs cat eye = analogous organs via convergent evolution. Correct.
The dark (carbonaria) peppered-moth form arose by mutation (then selected; industrial melanism). Correct.
